description:
Read-only git queries on a repository inside the allowed folders.
                        - action "status": branch and changed files (git status --short --branch)
                        - action "diff": changes with stat and patch; staged=true for the index; file limits it to one path
                        - action "log": last maxCount commits (default 20, max 200); file limits it to one path
                        Only these queries run. Nothing is staged, committed, checked out or pushed.
                        Output is capped at 200 KiB.

                        This command can be referenced as "DC: ..." or "use RemotePilot to ..." in your instructions.
name: git_query
